question: How does bodily worship from burning to worship parallel bliss-filled deity satisfaction?
premises: The body contains a sequence from burning to worship.
Bliss-essence fills the universal deity-satisfying act.
inference: Bodily worship and bliss-filled deity satisfaction are set in parallel.
uncertainties: Exact ritual sense of dāhādipūjāntaṃ remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Just as in the body there is a progression from burning to worship, so too the act is full of bliss-essence and satisfies all world-deities.
